strings.zh: Retinoid 分類與 4 代演進
RAR α / β / γ × RXR — receptor selectivity 與臨床意義
strings.en: RAR α / β / γ × RXR — receptor selectivity and clinical implications

strings.zh: 每個外用 retinoid 細節
前體：Retinaldehyde / Retinol / Retinyl palmitate / Bakuchiol
strings.en: Pro-forms: retinaldehyde / retinol / retinyl palmitate / bakuchiol

strings.zh: 組合相容性 — BPO / L-AA / niacinamide
把外用 retinoid 四代差別、Azelaic acid 雙重機轉、AHA pH 與 free acid concentration 對 penetration 的影響、BHA 親脂特性、PHA、與 BPO 的相容性、與 L-AA 的 pH 衝突、retinoid dermatitis 處置、孕期安全證據，全部整理成可直接帶上門診講解的版本。
strings.en: A clinic-ready synthesis covering the four retinoid generations, azelaic acid's dual mechanism, the influence of AHA pH and free-acid concentration on penetration, BHA's lipophilic profile, PHA, BPO compatibility, pH conflicts with L-AA, retinoid dermatitis management, and pregnancy safety evidence.

strings.zh: Retinoids 依照分子結構與年代分為四代：
strings.en: Retinoids are categorized into four generations by molecular structure and era:

strings.zh: 耐受度顯著優於 Tretinoin(meta-analyses Thiboutot 2008 等）
strings.en: Tolerability significantly superior to tretinoin (meta-analyses including Thiboutot 2008)
First-line for retinoid-naïve users and adolescents
Pregnancy Category C → still advised to avoid

strings.zh: RAR-γ selective(>20× over α/β)→ 系統毒性極低
strings.en: RAR-γ selective (>20× over α/β) → minimal systemic toxicity

strings.zh: 耐受性介於 Adapalene 與 Tretinoin 之間
對 Fitzpatrick IV-VI 暗膚色族群 PIH 安全（無反白風險）
strings.en: Safe for Fitzpatrick IV–VI skin (no risk of hypopigmentation rebound)

strings.zh: 初用 1-2 週可能有刺癢、burning；通常 self-limited
strings.en: Initial 1–2 weeks may cause stinging or burning; usually self-limited
Compatible with most actives (retinoid, AHA, BPO, niacinamide, L-AA)

strings.zh: 診所 chemical peel 濃度：20%、35%、50%、70%(glycolic)；更低 pH
strings.en: Clinic chemical-peel concentrations: 20%, 35%, 50%, 70% glycolic; lower pH

strings.zh: 濃度：OTC 0.5–2%(facial)、2% body wash、5–10% wart、20–30% chemical peel
strings.en: Concentrations: 0.5–2% facial OTC, 2% body wash, 5–10% wart, 20–30% chemical peel

strings.zh: 機轉：dissolve intercellular cement、降解 corneodesmosomes、anti-inflammatory(structural similarity to aspirin)
strings.en: Mechanism: dissolves intercellular cement, degrades corneodesmosomes, anti-inflammatory (structural similarity to aspirin)

strings.zh: 適應症：acne(comedonal type 為主）、verruca、psoriasis(keratolytic adjunct)、SD
strings.en: Indications: acne (mainly comedonal), verruca, psoriasis (keratolytic adjunct), seborrheic dermatitis

strings.zh: 分子大、滲透淺、刺激最低、有 humectant + antioxidant 性質
strings.en: Large molecule, shallow penetration, lowest irritation, humectant + antioxidant properties
Suitable for sensitive skin, rosacea, and post-procedure barrier impairment

strings.zh: 降低使用頻率（每天 → 隔日 → 每週 2 次）
strings.en: Decrease frequency (daily → every other day → twice weekly)

strings.zh: 洗臉換成 syndet、低 pH、無皂鹼
strings.en: Switch to soap-free, low-pH syndet cleansers

strings.zh: 強化 ceramide / cholesterol / FFA(3:1:1)修復
strings.en: Reinforce ceramide / cholesterol / FFA (3:1:1) barrier repair

strings.zh: 嚴重者短期外用 low-potency steroid 1 週
strings.en: Severe cases: short-course (1 week) low-potency topical corticosteroid

strings.zh: 降濃度(0.1% → 0.025% / Tretinoin → Adapalene / Adapalene → retinaldehyde)
區分 retinoid dermatitis vs. allergic contact dermatitis(罕見） — 後者廣泛 vesicular、超出塗藥區、patch test 陽性。
strings.en: Differentiate retinoid dermatitis from (rare) allergic contact dermatitis — the latter is more widespread, vesicular, extends beyond application area, and patch test is positive.

strings.zh: RAR-α 主導全身吸收後副作用
可與 BPO 同時使用
需要幾個 enzymatic conversion step
Pregnancy 安全 — FDA Cat B
分子越小 → 滲透越深
pH ≈ pKa 時 free acid 比例最大
strings.en: Free-acid fraction is maximized when pH ≈ pKa

strings.zh: 對 papulopustular rosacea 特別有效
孕期 acne / melasma / rosacea 首選
strings.en: First-line for pregnancy-era acne / melasma / rosacea

strings.zh: 完整臨床整理 — R2 必備
strings.en: Comprehensive clinical reference — essential for derm R2

strings.zh: 多 receptor 親和、刺激較高

strings.en: Mainly systemic use; psoriasis, disorders of cornification

strings.zh: 多芳香環，提高 receptor selectivity
專為 acne 設計、可用軀幹

strings.en: Pan-RAR; most potent and most irritating

strings.zh: RAR-γ selective（20 倍 vs α）；全身吸收最低
strings.en: RAR-γ selective (20× vs α); lowest systemic absorption

strings.zh: 可孕婦用（目前 evidence 有限）
NMF 之一；保濕加分；ichthyosis 也用
strings.en: Component of NMF; humectant bonus; also used in ichthyosis

strings.zh: 有抗菌活性 → acne / PIH；深膚色友善
strings.en: Antimicrobial activity → acne / PIH; safe for darker skin types
Mainly used for pH adjustment; antioxidant

strings.zh: BPO 將 tretinoin 氧化失活；早 BPO 晚 tretinoin 可
strings.en: BPO oxidizes and inactivates tretinoin; BPO morning + tretinoin night is acceptable

strings.zh: Microsphere 緩釋避免直接氧化
strings.en: Microsphere sustained release prevents direct oxidation

strings.zh: 初步顯示穩定；safety 仍需更多 RWD
strings.en: Preliminary stability data; more real-world safety data needed

strings.zh: ️ pH 衝突 + 刺激累加
建議 早 C 晚 A
不要同夜疊用；隔夜輪替可
strings.en: Avoid same-night layering; alternating-night rotation acceptable

strings.zh: nicotinic acid flushing 須 70°C 才生成，常溫無問題
strings.en: Nicotinic acid flush requires 70°C to form; ambient temperature is safe

strings.zh: 個性最溫和、相容性最好
melasma 標準；steroid 限期使用避免 atrophy
strings.en: Melasma standard; time-limit steroid use to avoid atrophy

strings.zh: case reports retinoid embryopathy 雖罕見
strings.en: Case reports of retinoid embryopathy, though rare
Precautionary principle; OTC products hard to regulate

strings.zh: 不應「保證孕期安全」標語
避免大面積、高濃度、長時間；局部小範圍 Tx 一般可
strings.en: Avoid wide-area, high-concentration, prolonged use; small focal applications generally OK

strings.zh: 低吸收；焦點 acne 安全選項
strings.en: Low absorption; safe option for focal acne

strings.zh: 口服明確避免；外用資料有限
strings.en: Oral clearly avoided; topical data limited
